Supernaphim from our own Master Spirit go with us all along the way, and they receive even failure not as a rebuke but as a meaningful delay. And when at last we fall into the final sleep, we are not alone; we will awaken on the shores of Paradise as children of eternity.

If the supernaphim are the angels of the central universe and the seraphim the angels of the local universes, the seconaphim are the ministering spirits of the superuniverses. Yet in degree of divinity they are much nearer the supernaphim than the seraphim (28:0.1).

Reflectivity is inherent in the nature of the seconaphim, and they work as living mirrors that instantly reflect even beings a thousand light-years away.

032:115: Paper 32 shows the local universe growing step by step—from the power directors’ gathering of energy, through Salvington and the architectural worlds, the Bright and Morning Star and the sons and daughters, and at last to mortal man. This slow evolution is not a flaw but wisdom. Instead of receiving perfection as a gift, we are meant to climb step by step and earn it for ourselves, and the perfection so gained pairs with inborn perfection to make the universe whole. Through it all the Father seems to stand far off, yet he is in the Creator Son, in the personality circuit, and in the Adjuster deep within our minds. 033:1: Who leads a local universe that the Father does not rule directly, and how?
033:4: In Paper 32 we saw the local universe grow, beginning with energy and reaching all the way to mortal man. Now Paper 33 shows how such a universe is actually governed.
033:5: The Universal Father certainly rules his vast creation, but in the administration of a local universe he functions only through the person of the Creator Son. Planning, policy, and administration are left to the Creator Son, the local universe Mother Spirit, and their offspring. The Son, together with his Spirit associate, delegates executive power to Gabriel and jurisdictional authority to the Constellation Fathers, the System Sovereigns, and the Planetary Princes (33:0.1).
033:6: Who, then, are the father and mother who lead this universe, and in what order are the executive, judicial, and legislative functions divided so that justice reaches even mortals like us?
033:8: ⟦Q 33:7.8⟧You are living in a well-ordered universe, and sooner or later you may depend upon being dealt with justly, even mercifully.⟦/Q⟧ (33:7.8)
033:12: Our Creator Son is the personalization of the 611,121st original concept arising simultaneously in the Universal Father and the Eternal Son. His headquarters is the threefold mansion of light on Salvington, so arranged because he has lived through all three phases of existence—spiritual, morontial, and material. Because of his final bestowal on Urantia he is also called Christ Michael (33:1.1).
033:13: Michael is not the Eternal Son, nor is he a member of the Trinity. Yet he has all the divine attributes and powers that the Eternal Son would show if he were on Salvington, and beyond that he represents the personal presence of the Father in this universe (33:1.2-1.3). So to our universe and its worlds the Sovereign Son is, to all practical intents and purposes, God (33:1.4).
033:24: The supreme personality, our creator parent
033:27: Some Creator Sons are more like the Father, some more like the Son; our Michael is more like the Eternal Son (33:2.1). His power is limited only by the gravity circuits centering on Paradise and by the reservation of final judgment on personality extinction to the Ancients of Days. Personality is the bestowal of the Father alone, but a Creator Son can initiate new designs of creatures (33:2.2).
033:28: When Michael returned from his final bestowal on Urantia, the Creative Mother Spirit subordinated herself to him, and with that he gained jurisdiction over all power in heaven and on earth (33:2.3). Through the experience of creature bestowal the Michaels become qualified to portray the experiential divinity of the Supreme Being, and no other beings have such qualifications for sole sovereignty (33:2.4). When Michael is absent from Salvington, Gabriel becomes regent (33:2.5).
033:30: The Universe Mother Spirit of Salvington is the 611,121st being of the sixth group of Supreme Spirits, and she volunteered to accompany Michael (33:3.2). The Son is sovereign, but in every detail of management the Spirit is co-supervisor, and the Son grants the Spirit co-ordinate rank and equal authority (33:3.3).

Michael then made the Spirit coruler, required all creatures to pledge loyalty to the Spirit as well, and issued the Proclamation of Equality, declaring that she is equal with him in personality and divine character (33:3.6).

033:49: Now the Son and the Spirit preside over the universe as a father and mother care for their family of sons and daughters, and in no act of creation does either work without the counsel and approval of the other (33:3.7-3.8).
033:51: The Bright and Morning Star is the highest spirit personality, born of the first joint act of the Creator Son and the Mother Spirit; there is only one in each local universe (33:4.1-4.2). He embodies both the divine will of the Son and the creative imagination of the Spirit, and he understands both seraphim and mortals broadly (33:4.3). He is not a creator, but he is a marvelous administrator, and the Son and the Spirit do not confer about important procedures other than creation and life-giving without him (33:4.4).

033:64: Gabriel and his staff are administrators, not teachers. During Michael’s bestowals he was the actual director of universe affairs, and since Michael’s mortal bestowal he has been closely associated with Urantia (33:4.7). Whatever our order, if we become administrators we will come under Gabriel’s direction (33:4.8).
033:66: The administration of personalities of Trinity origin ends with the superuniverse; the local universe is marked by the dual supervision of father and mother. Still, personalities from Paradise are present, and their head is Immanuel of Salvington, a Union of Days. He is also the representative of the Universal Father at the court of the Creator Son, and so his name is Immanuel (33:5.1).
033:67: Immanuel is so humble that he declines all worship, and he is the only personality in Nebadon who has never acknowledged subordination to Michael. He gives counsel only when asked (33:5.2). Faithfuls of Days are sent to the constellations, and they too help only when asked (33:5.4).

033:138: Paper 33 shows that a local universe is never run by the dictatorship of one ruler. The Father rules through the Creator Son, and the Son, by making the Mother Spirit his equal partner, shows us the pattern of the family. Gabriel takes charge of execution, the courts of adjudication, the constellations of legislation, and the systems of administration, while the Trinity ambassador stands by, giving counsel only when asked. The weightiest matters, such as eternal life, are referred to the higher superuniverse courts. Because of this order, in which authority is divided yet never at odds with itself, even we mortals of a small planet can trust that in the end we will be dealt with justly and mercifully.

034:4: In Paper 33 we saw that the Creator Son and the Universe Spirit rule the local universe together, like a father and a mother. Now Paper 34 focuses on the mother’s side—the local universe Mother Spirit.
034:5: When a Creator Son is personalized, the Infinite Spirit individualizes a new and unique representation of himself to go with him into space. This representation becomes the Son’s partner, first in physical organization and later in creating and caring for creatures (34:0.1). In physical creation the Son provides the pattern, and the Spirit materializes it into physical substance (34:0.3).
034:6: How did this Spirit become a distinct person, and through what circuits and ministries does she reach into the minds and lives of mortals, leading us from the bondage of the flesh to the liberty of the spirit?
034:12: When physical organization is finished, the Michael Son proclaims his intention to project life into the new universe. When Paradise acknowledges this, the Master Spirit of that superuniverse vanishes into the spiritual brilliance of the Deities and then reappears, and a tremendous spiritual flash, the primary eruption, takes place. At the same moment a new personal expression of the Infinite Spirit, the Divine Minister, is personalized in the presence of the Creator Son (34:1.1).
034:13: The technique of this event is a secret held within the bosom of the Trinity. But this much is certain: the Spirit presence of the time of physical organization was imperfectly differentiated from the Infinite Spirit, while now she gains a personal nature colored by the nature of the Master Spirit of that superuniverse (34:1.3). Because she was thus localized and personalized, the Spirit was later able to subordinate herself fully to the Creator Son (34:1.4).

034:19: After the proclamation of life creation
034:20: Personalized as the Divine Minister with the primary eruption

034:25: After the Creator Son becomes a Master Son, the personal traits of the Creative Mother Spirit are greatly enhanced, and she is personally recognized by all who come in contact with her (34:2.1). From the beginning she had the physical-control attributes of the Infinite Spirit, including antigravity, and after becoming a person she fully controls mind gravity in the local universe (34:2.2).
034:26: The Universe Spirits are basically alike in nature, but their techniques of function vary according to the Master Spirit through whom they originated (34:2.3). The Spirit never fails the Son in creating and preserving creatures. When the Life Carriers provide the physical bodies, the Universe Spirit contributes the breath of life (34:2.4-2.5). The presiding Spirit of Orvonton embodies the natures of the three Deities in balance, so though development is slower, a well-balanced creation is expected in the future (34:2.6).

034:38: The Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit are not limited by time and space, but most of their offspring are (34:3.1). The Creative Spirit is wholly independent of space and is equally and personally present everywhere in the universe, yet in her mind ministry she must take time into account (34:3.3-3.4). The Creator Son, on the other hand, is not hindered by time but is limited by space; he cannot be in two places at once (34:3.5).
034:45: Limited — one place at a time
034:53: So when the two are administratively united, they are practically free of both time and space within the local creation, for each always has access to the other’s freedom (34:3.6). Only absolute beings are independent of time and space in the absolute sense (34:3.7).

034:65: The Spirit of Truth is the spirit that a bestowal Son pours out upon a world, and it leads all truth seekers to him who is the personification of truth (34:4.5). Wherever the Son may be, the Spirit of Truth is not hindered, because it is functionally focalized in the Mother Spirit. The Mother Spirit, for her part, never leaves Salvington (34:4.6-4.7).
034:66: The seven adjutant mind-spirits are created by the Divine Minister and care for the minds of the human and subhuman orders (34:4.9-4.10). They are the seven spirits of God before the throne that the prophet saw (34:4.11). The adjutant of intuition helps the four control creatures of Salvington maintain directional control, and a sense of direction pointing north and south is fixed in every living thing (34:4.12-4.13).
034:86: On the inhabited worlds the Spirit begins with lifeless matter and in turn bestows plant life, animal life, and the first orders of human existence, and chiefly through the seven adjutants she leads mankind toward higher ideals (34:5.2). When the animal mind becomes receptive to the adjutants of worship and wisdom, mind evolution crosses the threshold of spiritual ministry, and that mind is included in the circuit of the Holy Spirit (34:5.3).
034:87: A mind that has received the Holy Spirit gains the capacity to choose a Thought Adjuster, and when a bestowal Son pours out the Spirit of Truth, every normal mind becomes ready to receive an Adjuster (34:5.4). The Spirit of Truth depends greatly on man’s personal acceptance, while the Holy Spirit works partly independently of human will and partly according to its co-operation (34:5.5).

034:94: The universe son of the Eternal Son, the Creator Son
034:96: The Paradise Father, indwelling the mind
034:98: The presence of these three spirits together is the symmetry of spiritual endowment, and by it mortals are qualified to realize consciously the faith-fact of sonship with God (34:5.7).
034:100: However divinity may appear, in human experience Deity is always one, and spiritual influences of many origins are one in function (34:6.2). The divine spirit comes down through long steps to meet us as we are and where we are, and it does not stop until it has carried the soul back up to those heights (34:6.3).
034:101: Spiritual life too is used up, so renewal by the spirit is needed (34:6.5). Even the highest doctrine cannot change character as a dead theory; it comes alive only when the divine spirit breathes into it (34:6.6). It is not enough for the spirit to be poured out; it must direct every phase of human experience, and a soul so watered becomes almost independent of material surroundings for its joy in living (34:6.7-6.8).
034:105: When we freely accept the leading of the spirit, our assurance of divine contact grows, and the spirit bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God (34:6.12). In such a life appear the fruits of the spirit: love, joy, peace, long-suffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, and temperance (34:6.13).
034:107: The flesh of animal origin does not naturally bear the fruits of the spirit (34:7.1). The mortals of normal worlds do not experience such bitter conflict between spirit and flesh; their ascent is more like a process of educational training (34:7.2-7.3). There are two reasons why Urantia suffers such an unusually severe struggle (34:7.4-7.5).
034:112: Lost the moral support of a well-ordered society

034:116: Yet the faith sons who enter the kingdom of the spirit and do the Father’s will suffer far less from this warfare, for Jesus showed a new way of living (34:7.6). The natural appetites of the body do not conflict even with the highest spiritual attainment (34:7.7). So we should not doubt or fear failure (34:7.8).
034:118: For in every dark hour, at every crossroad in the forward struggle, the Spirit of Truth will always speak, saying, “⟦Q 34:7.8⟧This is the way⟦/Q⟧.” (34:7.8)
034:121: Paper 34 shows the Mother Spirit beginning as a helper in physical creation, becoming a person with the primary eruption, and at last becoming the equal partner of the Creator Son. Through the seven adjutant mind-spirits she cares for animal minds; as the Holy Spirit she embraces minds that have crossed the threshold of worship and wisdom; and together with the Spirit of Truth and the Adjuster she works as one within us. On Urantia the struggle between spirit and flesh is unusually great because of the failures of Caligastia and Adam, yet the spirit does not drive but leads, and when we willingly co-operate it brings forth the fruits of the spirit. At every dark crossroad the Spirit of Truth shows us the way, so we can go forward without fear.
